dump_distribution: Not included in Git; obtain separately and place at data/db/od_dashboard_tables.dump

restore_steps.0_configure: Copy deploy.example.env to deploy.env in the project root and set PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD
2_prepare_schema_sql: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO postgres;
GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO public;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis WITH SCHEMA public;
restore_steps.4_verify: SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name;

building_emissions_note: Capacity-allocated expanded trips (trips_weighted_rules/dest); UI shows weighted totals, not leg counts
